test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six numbers, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6, are written on the different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the given figure. Find the number on the face opposite to 5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/accd0e294f73c4c195be0d68e54839d5d10d8c75d31745f6d2fbcbdd60c01654.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 3 is common on both the dices, it is clear that 1, 2, 4, and 6 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 5 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/072f2867860c9169a46fa00b1a9b7836dbed8553e6894b04216ce2844a32d4fd.png] 

Opposite pairs:

2 → 4

1 → 6

3 → 5

So, the opposite side of "5" will be side "3".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
